name: What questions should I ask a luxury home designer before hiring them?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask before hiring a luxury home designer in Los Angeles or Beverly Hills?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask before hiring a luxury home designer in Los Angeles or Beverly Hills?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a luxury home designer, ask questions that reveal how they work, not just what their portfolio looks like. You want to know whether they handle concept development only or provide full-service support through procurement and installation. Ask how they manage budgets, how many revisions are included, and how they coordinate with the architect and builder. In luxury projects, especially in Los Angeles, process matters because delays and scope changes can be expensive. It is also smart to ask how they source materials, how they handle custom items, and whether they have experience with the type of home you are building or renovating. A designer should be able to explain how they protect the project from decision fatigue, cost overruns, and mismatched finishes. The best answer is usually specific and practical, not vague or sales-driven. That makes it easier to tell whether the designer is a fit for a high-touch, high-budget home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about recent projects, scope of services, budget range, design process, procurement handling, team structure, and how they coordinate with architects and builders. Also ask how they handle revisions, long lead-time items, and site issues so you know whether they can manage a complex luxury project end to end.
